_about: Light modernisation, passage by passage. Keys are thought ids (# in thoughts.xlsx); each maps words in the source to the words in our quote. The general rules (thou -> you, hath -> has, translator's brackets) live in tools/build_entries.py. check_quotes.py applies these to the source and the quote must then appear in it word for word.
